BRANDING / 05 OF 06

Status Tag

An identity built around connection.

A visual identity and digital direction for a platform centred on social discovery and location-based connections.

THE PROJECT

The idea behind the identity.

Status Tag brings social networking and location-based discovery together. Its identity is designed to feel personal and approachable, translating the idea of finding people and places into a simple visual system.

DESIGN DIRECTION

A place to connect.

The symbol combines a location pin with a check mark, making the idea of tagging a place immediately recognisable. A handwritten wordmark adds a personal touch, balanced by a structured interface and a focused purple palette.

THE VISUAL LANGUAGE

Colour sets the tone.

Plum#753075
Charcoal#262626
Lilac#B9A2FE
TYPOGRAPHY

Lato

A humanist sans serif chosen to keep the digital experience clear and approachable.

IN APPLICATION

A social idea, brought to the screen.

The visual system continues into the interface through lilac accents, clear layouts and a consistent approach to profiles, discovery and navigation.
